title: 经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版） / Current-Account FX Business Guide (2020)
evidence: Read both retrieved chunks. Arts.54–67 and 79 are the operative individual-FX provisions.
limitations: PDF is the 2020 instrument; amendment status is tracked separately at CN02. Branch practice can require more documents than the minimum text.
supports: Art.54: annual convenience quota USD 50,000 for individual settlement and domestic-individual purchase.
Art.55–57: ID-only inside quota; domestic individual completes purchase application.
Art.58: overseas individual settlement above USD 50,000 pays counterparty RMB account directly.
Art.59: overseas individual lawful current-account RMB income purchase with ID and source materials including tax vouchers; no annual cap stated; permanent-residence-card holders use quota.
Art.60: reconversion of unused RMB against original exchange memo within 24 months; small daily reconversion tiers.
Art.61: close-relative proxy; Art.62 splitting leads to watch list for current year plus two years.
Art.64: domestic individual outbound FX from FX account USD 50,000/day on ID, above with documents; cash USD 10,000/day.
Art.65: overseas individual FX-account outbound on ID.
Art.66: e-commerce/market-procurement/border-trade settlement outside convenience quota with evidence.
Art.67: domestic FX transfers only to self or close relatives.
Art.79: overseas-account witnessing requires foreign visa valid at least three months.

title: Amendment status of the 2020 Current-Account FX Guide
evidence: Page marks the guide 已修改 by 汇发〔2023〕8号 and 汇发〔2023〕28号.
limitations: The listed amendments delete/rewrite provisions outside the personal-FX articles relied on here; do not treat the 2020 PDF as unamended in all respects.

issuer: People’s Bank of China / SAFE republished by SAFE Tianjin
title: 个人外汇管理办法 / Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (PBOC Order 2006 No.3)
evidence: Read Arts.3, 9, 13, 22, 26 and 37.
limitations: Art.37 identity-document definitions conflict with the one-year residence definition in State Council Regulation Art.52(2); see Flagged F01.
supports: Art.37: domestic individual = PRC ID holder; overseas individual = passport or HK/Macao/Taiwan permit holder.
Art.13: overseas individual may purchase and remit lawful current-account RMB income with ID and supporting materials.
Art.22: overseas individual property-sale purchase/remittance follows property-transfer rules / SAFE approval.
Art.26: outward transfer of lawful domestic property follows the separate property-transfer measures.

title: 汇发〔2021〕13号 — further facilitation of individual FX business
evidence: Read notice text on repeat salary purchase and tuition documentation.
limitations: Facilitation is documentary, not a new annual quota or a tax exemption.
supports: Overseas individual working in China may repeat salary purchase within contract validity at the same bank without resubmitting duplicate documents.
Tuition payments receive analogous repeat-document facilitation.
Banks apply substance-over-form special handling.

title: 2026-07-13 FAQ restating overseas-individual purchase under Art.59
evidence: Full FAQ read; restates ID plus source-of-funds materials including tax vouchers for lawful current-account RMB income.
limitations: A FAQ is not a branch guarantee; account classification and document acceptance remain factual.

title: 2025-07-15 FAQ on non-taxable income and use of purchased FX
evidence: Full FAQ read; tax voucher not required where the income is not taxable; purchased FX may be remitted, deposited or carried out subject to rules.
limitations: Does not prove the income is non-taxable; that is a tax-law question.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 / Foreign Exchange Administration Regulation (State Council Decree 532)
limitations: Art.52(2) includes a foreigner continuously resident in China for one year as a domestic individual, conflicting with CN03 Art.37 for bank practice; see F01.
supports: Art.5: no restriction on current-account international payments and transfers.
Art.22 paragraph 3: lawfully terminated FIE liquidation proceeds belonging to foreign investors may be converted/remitted after liquidation and tax payment.
Arts.39–40: evasion/illegal arbitrage fine up to 30%, serious 30%–100%, criminal referral where constituted.
Art.45: private/disguised FX trading penalised; Art.48 individual reporting/document failures up to CNY 50,000.

title: 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 / Interim Measures on Outward Transfer of Personal Property (PBOC Announcement 2004 No.16)
evidence: Read the interim measures: emigration and inheritance limbs, one-time application, staging and approval tiers.
limitations: Only emigration and inheritance transfers; not a general savings-repatriation route.
supports: First remittance no more than 50%; after one year no more than half the remainder; after two years the balance; CNY 200,000 or less may go at once after approval.
Provincial approval up to CNY 500,000; above that SAFE headquarters.
Funds go to applicant’s own overseas account; no domestic cash extraction.

issuer: SAFE Hebei (service guide; text includes Anhui handling details)
title: Emigration property-transfer purchase/payment service guide under Capital-Account Guide 2024 §6.4.3.1
evidence: Read both chunks; document list includes hukou cancellation, consular residence proof/apostille, income/property evidence and tax certificate; 20 working days, no fee, in-person.
limitations: The retrieved .doc mixes Hebei title with Anhui address details; use as a service-guide example, confirm local office.

title: Inheritance property-transfer purchase/payment administrative-licence service guide
evidence: Read chunk 0 and following; foreign-citizen heir documents, inheritance proof, decedent property proof, tax certificate, 20 working days, no fee.
limitations: Provincial example; apply to the decedent’s former hukou locality per CN25.

title: 汇发〔2024〕12号 — Capital-Account FX Business Guide (2024) notice
evidence: Notice retrieved; identifies the 2024 capital-account guide and issuance.
limitations: Notice alone does not supply every checklist; use CN09/CN10/CN14 for retrieved operational text.

title: 资本项目外汇业务指引（2024年版） PDF
evidence: Retrieved chunks 0–5 only; table of contents locates §6.4 personal property transfer, §7.10 divestment remittance and §7.12 profit remittance.
limitations: Full §6.4/§7.10/§7.12 body text was not retrieved from this PDF; do not quote unseen clauses. Operational guides CN09/CN10/CN14 and older Tianjin guide are used where read.

title: 汇发〔2025〕43号 — deepening cross-border investment/financing FX facilitation
evidence: Read notice: removes FDI preliminary-expense pre-registration and FIE reinvestment registration; allows FX-profit reinvestment; paragraph (九) eases overseas-individual home-purchase settlement.
limitations: Reinvestment facilitation is not cash repatriation to a personal US account.

issuer: SAFE Anhui mirror of SAFE operational guide
title: 深化跨境投融资外汇管理便利化政策操作指引 / Operational guide to Huifa 2025 No.43
evidence: Read chunks 0 and 3. Property-sale outbound section caps remittance at sale price less taxes/fees, requires tax-certificate amount match and completed title transfer.
limitations: Also covers reinvestment and home purchase; only the property-sale outbound rules are used for repatriation mechanics.

title: Current-law index as of 2026-06-30
evidence: Retrieved index confirms listed instruments remain in force, including 汇发〔2025〕47号, 汇发〔2025〕43号 and 银发〔2026〕63号.
limitations: Index is a validity aid, not a substitute for reading the instrument.

title: 汇发〔2017〕29号 — large overseas cash withdrawals by bank cards
evidence: Read notice: CNY 100,000 per person per year across all domestic cards; CNY 10,000 per card per day; over-limit suspension this year and next.
limitations: Card spending abroad is distinct from cash withdrawal and does not consume the USD 50,000 purchase quota.

issuer: ICBC Beijing branch (bank guidance implementing SAFE/Customs rules)
title: Carrying foreign-currency cash out of China — permit tiers and fee
evidence: Read bank guidance: ≤USD 5,000 no permit; USD 5,000–10,000 bank permit; >USD 10,000 SAFE permit; same-day second exit USD 500, 15-day second exit USD 1,000; permit CNY 10, 30 days single use.
limitations: Bank branch guidance, not the regulator instrument itself; confirm with SAFE/Customs before travel. BOC tariff BK01 waives the CNY 10 permit fee through 2026-12-31.

issuer: People’s Bank of China and nine departments
title: 银发〔2021〕237号 — virtual-currency trading/speculation risk notice
evidence: Read notice: virtual-currency-related business is illegal financial activity; overseas exchanges serving mainland residents likewise.
limitations: No fixed percentage penalty is stated in this notice; do not invent one.

title: Underground-bank enforcement case explanation (对敲 / matched payments)
evidence: Read case: 49 transactions totalling USD 2.057 million drew a CNY 1.059 million fine under Art.45.
limitations: Case-specific fine; not a tariff or safe harbour.

title: Individual Income Tax Law of the People’s Republic of China
evidence: Read Arts.1–3, 6, 16: 183-day residency; comprehensive 3%–45%; business 5%–35%; interest/dividends/property transfer/lease/incidental 20%; RMB conversion at central parity.
limitations: The law taxes income categories; currency exchange itself is not an enumerated income category. Specific exemptions and taxable bases still require facts.

issuer: MOF / State Taxation Administration (Ningxia tax mirror)
title: Announcement 2020 No.3 on foreign-source individual income tax
evidence: Read announcement: foreign-income source rules, per-country credit limits, five-year carryforward, filing 1 March–30 June following year, credit requires foreign tax receipts.
limitations: Applies to PRC tax residents with foreign income; not a US tax rule.

title: 财税〔2008〕132号 — temporary IIT exemption on savings-deposit interest
evidence: Read notice: savings-deposit interest arising on or after 2008-10-09 is temporarily exempt from IIT.
limitations: Temporary exemption for savings-deposit interest; do not generalise to all interest, dividends or investment products.

issuer: MOF Tax Policy Department / STA Income Tax Department (Shanghai tax mirror)
title: Q&A confirming savings-deposit interest exemption includes RMB and foreign-currency savings
evidence: Read Q&A: exemption includes RMB and foreign-currency savings-deposit interest; segmented historical rates.
limitations: Confirms scope of CN22; not a exemption for non-deposit interest.

title: 个人财产转移购付汇业务问答（六） — definition of emigration/inheritance transfer
evidence: Full FAQ read; emigration transfer concerns property owned before acquiring immigrant status; inheritance transfer concerns foreign citizen/HK/Macao/Taiwan heir.
limitations: Does not create a route for a US citizen by birth with ordinary savings and no inheritance.

title: 个人财产转移购付汇业务问答（七） — approving office
evidence: Full FAQ read; emigration transfer approved by former hukou locality; inheritance by decedent’s former hukou locality; multiple decedents may be combined at one locality.
limitations: Jurisdiction rule only.

title: 26 U.S.C. §988 — foreign currency transactions
evidence: Read subsection (e): personal-transaction exchange gain not recognised unless gain exceeds USD 200; ordinary character is the statutory default elsewhere in §988.
limitations: IRS Publication 525 describes gain above USD 200 as capital gain; character conflict is flagged F02. The USD 200 amount is a recognition threshold, not a tax-free allowance.

title: Publication 525 — foreign currency transactions
evidence: Read tip: personal foreign-currency gain need not be included unless more than USD 200; if more than USD 200, report as capital gain.
limitations: Publication character guidance differs from §988 ordinary default; see F02.

title: Foreign tax credit
evidence: Read page: credit vs deduction, Form 1116, no credit for tax on FEIE-excluded income, treaty-reduced rate only.
limitations: Credit limitation and baskets depend on facts; no personal credit amount is computed.

title: Foreign earned income exclusion
evidence: Read page: US citizens/residents taxed on worldwide income; bona fide residence or 330-day physical-presence test; foreign tax home; exclusions list.
limitations: Page displays older indexed exclusion amounts; current-year exclusion amount is left unverified rather than copied from a stale page.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
evidence: Read thresholds and filing channels: FBAR >USD 10,000 aggregate any time; Form 8938 USD 50k/75k US single, 100k/150k US joint, 200k/300k abroad single, 400k/600k abroad joint; 8938 penalty structure.
limitations: Thresholds are reporting triggers, not tax rates.

title: IRM 4.26.16 — FBAR penalties (rev. 2025-08-26)
evidence: Read IRM: FBAR penalties inflation-adjusted per 31 CFR 1010.821; incorporates Bittner per-report non-willful rule.
limitations: Exact current-year adjusted dollar maxima were not read from an official adjusted table; left blank and flagged F03.

title: 2023 NTF training paper — Form 3520 foreign gift/trust reporting
evidence: Read paper: foreign individual/estate gifts >USD 100,000 aggregate; penalty 5% per month up to 25%; due dates including abroad extension.
limitations: Training paper explains reporting; it does not make a gift taxable income.

title: U.S.–China income tax treaty (1984) and protocol
evidence: Read chunks 0, 6 and 7: dividend/interest/royalty source caps generally 10%; equipment royalties taxed on 70% (effective 7%); Protocol paragraph 2 saving clause preserves US taxation of citizens.
limitations: Treaty relief requires residence/beneficial-owner facts; no tax sparing clause was found.

title: Currency and monetary instruments reporting
evidence: Read page: more than USD 10,000 transported into/out of the US requires FinCEN 105; family aggregate; forfeiture risk.
limitations: Reporting is not a tax or a prohibition on carrying lawful funds.

title: 31 U.S.C. §5321 — civil penalties including FBAR
evidence: Read subsection (a)(5): non-willful statutory cap USD 10,000; willful maximum greater of USD 100,000 or 50% of transaction/account balance; reasonable-cause exception; six-year assessment period.
limitations: Statutory amounts are inflation-adjusted in practice; current adjusted dollars left blank. Per-violation/per-report characterisation requires IRM/case law.

title: Personal service tariff effective 2025-11-11 (item 210105008 and notes)
evidence: Read tariff: cross-border TT/draft 0.1%, min CNY 50, max CNY 260; cable CNY 150 international (CNY 80 HK/Macao/Taiwan); amendment ≤CNY 50; refund CNY 20; e-channel same base price with channel discounts.
limitations: Provider price only, not legal permission. Notes: USD full-amount arrival +USD 15 where payee bank accounts with BOC New York, otherwise +USD 25 for qualifying US domestic banks; overseas bank charges passed at cost; Great Wall debit cross-border ATM CNY 12+1% cap CNY 112; Great Wall International debit 0.5% min USD 3 max USD 5; FX-carry permit CNY 10 waived 2025-04-01 to 2026-12-31; overseas-account witnessing ≤CNY 400.

title: Foreign-exchange rate board (USD row)
evidence: Captured 2026-11-08 UTC. USD spot buy 666.48, spot sell 669.29, BOC conversion/reference 671.68 CNY per 100 USD; latest retrieved display stamp 2026-11-09 07:14:36.
limitations: Board is reference-only; actual execution uses online/branch quote. Display date is later than report date; flagged F04. Earlier session capture showed same rates at 05:30, so the board is dynamic.

title: Announcement adjusting personal ATM fees effective 2026-11-11
evidence: Read announcement: UnionPay overseas ATM CNY 12+1% cap CNY 112 unchanged; Mastercard/VISA 2.5%, min USD 3 max USD 40 from 2026-11-11.
limitations: Future-effective relative to report date; do not apply new Mastercard/VISA price before 2026-11-11.

title: Wealth management and personal banking tariff effective 2026-10-31
evidence: Read chunks 0–2. Items 2.2.4.1/2.2.4.2: private-banking personal clients free TT and cable; Premier and Advance 0.1% min CNY 100 max CNY 500 plus CNY 120 cable; Premier Elite/International free; USD full-delivery pre-charge CNY 200 with later top-up.
limitations: Free means HSBC’s own listed fees only; correspondent/receiving charges and taxes excluded. Premier eligibility includes CNY 500,000 monthly average balance or paid CNY 300 monthly fee and other routes. Same-name Global Transfer waivers are product-specific, not a universal Premier wire waiver.

title: Personal customer reference for FX settlement/purchase and remittance documents
url: https://www.hsbc.com.cn/content/dam/hsbc/cn/docs/document-download/办理外币结汇购汇及汇款业务的个人客户参考.pdf
evidence: Read 8-page guide: quota rules, overseas individual no annual purchase quota, property-sale documents, USD 50,000/day and USD 10,000/day cash thresholds.
limitations: Provider guidance restating regulation; not a substitute for SAFE rules.

title: Service price index effective 2026-08-08
evidence: Index retrieved; international-business fee section is published as GIF images whose numeric wire fees were not extractable.
limitations: ICBC numeric wire fees remain blank/unverified; overseas-branch tariffs are not substitutes.

title: Guide to CNY transfers — sending from CNY
evidence: Read both chunks: non-mainland Chinese only, worked in China, tax records within last 3 years, own-name recipient only; bank-app funding max CNY 300,000, Alipay max CNY 50,000; overall limit based on after-tax salary; SkyRemit transfers share the remaining limit.
limitations: Provider product terms; legal permission still depends on SAFE rules and documents. The shared SkyRemit/Wise limit is material.

title: Send money to the USA from China — live pricing page
evidence: Captured 2026-11-08: 1 CNY = 0.1498 USD; 200,000 CNY bank-transfer fee 1,224.40 CNY after 31.93 CNY volume discount; Wise-balance cheapest 1,208.11 CNY; >USD 25,000 volume discount; US 1% remittance excise from 2026-01-01 applies only to US-outbound physical-instrument transfers, not Wise.
limitations: Dynamic quote; earlier session capture showed 1,224.43/31.90/1,208.14, so values moved during research. ?amount= query did not change server-rendered quote; no 40-point Wise fee curve is inferred.

title: Pricing hub
evidence: Retrieved pricing hub: fees from 0.23%; USD wire/SWIFT receive USD 6.11.
limitations: Generic pricing, not a CNY-outbound transaction quote; CNY-specific pricing URL /us/pricing/cny-to-usd returned 404.

title: Homepage transfer calculator and product terms
evidence: Captured 2026-11-08: CNY 79 fixed fee; CNY 500–300,000 per transfer; 1 CNY real-time 0.149900 USD vs final 0.149496 USD, displayed 0.27% FX markup; 7×24, fastest 5 minutes normally 24–48h; Alipay/WeChat/bank funding; ID plus tax invoice/work certificate onboarding.
limitations: Widget send/receive fields were internally inconsistent in the retrieved markup (send 33,333 CNY but receive 1,483.16 USD); only the displayed rate pair and fixed fee are used, and the inconsistency is flagged F05. Marketing rate-superiority claim is not used.

title: Send money from China — outbound product page
evidence: Read page: online only via partner banks (CEB, SPDB, PSBC, BOC mobile-only) or in person at listed banks; cash pickup abroad; bank-account delivery temporarily unavailable; no published outbound fee schedule.
limitations: Outbound fees and exact China limits remain blank/unverified; 2019 promo page expired.

title: Wealth Management Connect — Southbound scheme
evidence: Read HKMA page: mainland GBA investors only; RMB via CIPS; closed loop back to same mainland account; aggregate CNY 150bn / individual CNY 3m.
limitations: Closed-loop investment scheme, not a route to repatriate money to a US personal account.
